title: 1939 aerial photograph centres (ASCS flights BXQ Cass / BXU Hubbard)
source: Minnesota Historical Aerial Photographs Online (MHAPO), University of Minnesota Borchert Map Library — photo-centre service gis5.uspatial.umn.edu/arcgis/rest/services/mhapo/MHAPO_dynamic/MapServer/0

flights.BXQ: Cass County, flown 15 Aug, 18 Aug, 17 Sep 1939, rolls 1-9, 1:20,000, 9-inch contact prints
flights.BXU: Hubbard County, flown 21 Aug 1939, rolls 1-5, 1:20,000, 9-inch contact prints

notes: Each point is the centre of one 1939 frame; the frame itself is about 2.8 miles across, so a centre outside the watershed can still show watershed ground.

Only 2 of the 500 frames show lake water (bxu04058 centre on Walker Bay water; bxu03065 Walker Bay west shore). The lake frames of the Cass flight (BXQ roll 5 entirely, most of roll 3) were never digitized — a holdings gap, not an index gap.
Beltrami County has no 1939 flight; its earliest is 1940.

Download URLs follow the verified pattern https://geo.lib.umn.edu/dnr_historical_aerial_imagery/airphotos/usda/<symbol>/y1939/<photo_id>.jpg, no login required; each frame about 3.7 MB, ~5600x5500 px, ~0.82 m/px.
Frame dates are stamped on the frames themselves; per-frame dates are not in the MHAPO service.
Status values: on_lake (centre on lake water), shows_lake_water, in_watershed (centre inside HUC8 07010102, 101 excluding the 2 lake frames), near_watershed (footprint touching), outside_watershed.
